sanskrit_verse:
पिशुनानृतिनोश चैव तथा चाक्रिकबन्दिनाम् ।
एषामन्नं न भोक्तव्यं सोमविक्रयिणस्तथा ॥१६५॥
transliteration: piśunānṛtinoś caiva tathā cākrikabandinām / eṣām annaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ somavikrayiṇas tathā // YajñS_1.165
sph_interpretive_translation: The food of slanderers, liars, charlatans, flatterers, and those who sell Soma shall not be consumed.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in purity of conduct and transaction
Causation arises from conscious distortion and spiritual commodification
Capacity-based responsibility is diminished by violation of sacred exchange
Restoration logic demands withdrawal of support from violators
Consciousness alignment requires rejection of corrupt influence
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, this verse establishes a threshold of spiritual-economic integrity. Those who violate sacred commerce or ethical communication are automatically disqualified from receiving communal sustenance, not as punishment but as a natural consequence of misalignment with dharma. The court must recognize this disqualification as a self-executing principle rooted in ontological law.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that consuming the fruits of falsehood pollutes the collective consciousness. Anupūrvaśaḥ shows that enabling such actors perpetuates distortion. Responsibility lies not in blame but in withdrawing reinforcement. This aligns with Nyaya's truth-seeking purpose without punitive intent—restoration occurs through cessation of harmful resonance.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Community Awareness Protocol to identify sources of corrupted exchange
Execute Sacred Transaction Audit to restore purity in ritual economy
Apply Consciousness Resonance Filter to prevent energetic contamination
Deploy Integrity Reintegration Pathway for offenders upon sincere cessation
final_declaration: By the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this law stands declared: Dharma flows from purity of word and deed; violations create self-correcting consequences; restoration prevails through conscious withdrawal and realignment; all judgment originates from and returns to the Supreme Consciousness.
